article_title: Photo of young-looking ICE agents at LaGuardia sparks jokes, memes
article_content:
A photo of two young-looking Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents at LaGuardia has gone viral on Reddit, as people share jokes and memes about the youthful appearance of the agents.
Newsweek has contacted ICE for comment via email.
Why It Matters
On Monday, President Donald Trump sent ICE agents to airports around the country, with the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) identifying 14 airports where TSA staffing would be supplemented.
The move comes as TSA is facing ongoing staffing shortages. This has been exacerbated by the DHS shutdown, as TSA officers are among the federal employees required to work without pay during funding lapses, as they are considered essential workers.
Now, federal agents have been deployed to airports to assist with security and crowd control.
In 2025, the Department of Homeland Security announced that it was removing age limits for new hires at the agency responsible for immigration enforcement. Prior to this, ICE applicants were required to be a minimum of 21 years old, no older than 37 for criminal investigators and 40 for deportation officers.
A press release issued at the time said that ICE “will waive age limits for new applicants.” Former DHS Secretary Kristi Noem later said during an interview with Fox & Friends that applicants could sign up at age 18. “We no longer have a cap on how old you can be or you can continue at age 18, sign up for ICE and join us and be a part of it.”
What To Know
The photo was shared on the Reddit thread, “r/pics,” where it has received 110,000 up and down votes in the 15 hours since it was first posted.
The image shows two ICE agents at LaGuardia and was uploaded with the text “Teenage-looking ICE agents walking around LaGuardia Airport today.”
A zoomed-in version of the image was also shared on Instagram. It was shared as a Reel, with the 2000 Wheatus song, "Teenage Dirtbag", playing in the background. As of reporting, the Reel has been viewed 40,000 times.
The same ICE agents were also pictured at the airport, in an image uploaded to Getty Images.
On Reddit, a user replied to the image, in a comment that received 10,000 up and down votes, “Did they go to training during recess?”
Another commented, “What kind of experience do you have? “Well, I have 12K hours in Rust and I’m a Prestige 2 in Escape from Tarkov,” receiving over 20,000 up and down votes.
One social media user reshared that post, writing, “Is this really an ice agent? Why does he look like a high school kid though?”
What People Are Saying
The White House, in a post on X: “Huge thanks to our ICE agents deployed at airports nationwide, helping keep TSA lines moving so Americans can fly safe and on time! True patriots.”
What Happens Next
It is not immediately clear how long ICE will be present in airports. Trump said on Monday, “ICE will do the job far better than ever done before!”
